title: Report totals are the same split or not when Show Unassigned is on
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active staff member at the test location with the "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Make sure the test location's Shop Supplies Charge is 0% and nothing else is invoiced at the test location today.
  • Create a work order for this test for that customer with one labor line of 2.00 hours at $100.00 an hour and one part sold at $50.00, its one "Sales Representative" set to sales rep A, and invoice it today.
  • Open Reports > Sales By Representative in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide, with the date range set to today.
custom_steps:
1. Turn Show Unassigned on and write down the report total.
  2. Reverse the invoice of the work order.
  3. Add the "Sales Representative - Parts" field to the work order.
  4. Set "Sales Representative - Parts" to "Unassigned".
  5. Invoice the work order again.
  6. Open Reports > Sales By Representative.
  7. Set the date range to today.
  8. Turn Show Unassigned on and read the report total.
  9. Turn Show Unassigned off and read the report total.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The total is $250.00 (200.00 + 50.00).

Step 2:

  • The invoice is reversed.

Step 3:

  • The card shows "Sales Representative - Labor" and "Sales Representative - Parts".

Step 4:

  • "Sales Representative - Parts" reads "Unassigned".

Step 5:

  • The new invoice is created with Labor sales rep A and Parts Unassigned.

Step 6:

  • The Sales By Representative report opens.

Step 7:

  • The report shows today's date range.

Step 8:

  • The total is still $250.00.
  • Sales rep A has a $200.00 Labor row.
  • Unassigned has a $50.00 Parts row.

Step 9:

  • The total is $200.00.
  • The Unassigned parts side is left out.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11269 (Story 5, Credit each side on the invoice and in Sales By Representative)

  • S5-R14: “With Show Unassigned on, the report's totals are the same whether invoices are split or not. With it off, a side credited to Unassigned is left out of the totals, as Unassigned money is today.”
  • S5-R18: “A side with no representative is credited to Unassigned, which shows when Show Unassigned is on, as today.”
  • Goals: “Every dollar of an invoice is credited to exactly one side, and the report's totals never change because of a split.”
